revisedWithBlenderReference.title: V5 · NEBULA CLIFF STATION
revisedWithBlenderReference.details: A cozy frontier space outpost tucked into luminous alien rock cliffs. Continuous undulating indigo and dusty-violet rock enclosure, with tiny pale mineral insets and sparse lavender plants ONLY along perimeter. Rear hero is a custom sculpted large crescent-shaped satellite receiver with a polished pale silver inner surface, mounted on an ivory and copper gimbal pedestal against the rock skyline, offset rather than centered over the field. A small group of asymmetrical white-and-teal capsule research huts connected by a short peripheral deck on a side terrace, rounded corner windows emitting warm honey light. The reference image's ACTUAL teal transformer, switch cabinet, three-cylinder capacitor bank, copper reel, low teal-roof vent and copper elbow are clearly visible power/service equipment on lower terrace and near entrance. Match those actual asset silhouettes and colors, integrate with alien architecture. Center remains a flat expansive matte dusty lavender field with no vegetation or crystals, readable for creature capture. Open framed white gateway through low cliff shoulders, freestanding sign Orbit Outpost. A soft nebula sky confined to backdrop with one small distant planet, stars subtle; bright readable grounded build with grass road outside. No colossal orbit ring, observatory dome, glowing portal, spikes across floor or overhanging structures above center. Handcrafted cliff/habitat composition with more natural character than a sterile space-station bowl.

Reference image 1 shows the actual Blender props already built. Accurately reproduce their shapes, proportions and colors in the environment: chunky TEAL TRANSFORMER with flat slate lid, side cooling fins, TWO CREAM RIDGED INSULATORS connected by straight COPPER BUS and small yellow lightning badge; one cream four-skirt insulator on square base; upright COPPER-FLANGE CABLE REEL full of dark cable; THREE tall teal CYLINDERS on one square base with cream tips and triangular COPPER CONNECTIONS; teal SWITCH CABINET with three tiny pale indicators, side handle and low black vents; low slate VENT HOUSING with teal projecting roof and front gray slats; short COPPER ELBOW on a square dark mounting plate; slim TEAL BOLLARD with two muted yellow bands and white cap. Include clearly recognizable reference props at sensible scale on foreground side equipment pads and beside the landmarks. They must not become generic invented substitutes. Do not include gallery plinths, labels, title from reference or a separate asset sheet. Architecture and region terrain are new concepts. A polished stylized 3D world with thick beveled shapes, crafted modular geometry, lovely soft game lighting and visual depth, plausible to build using Blender meshes in Roblox. Landscape view near the foreground entrance at moderate elevated player-scale angle; see a large portion of interior and the hero skyline. Region is a compact bounded playable enclave connected to the existing green-grass overworld via a flat wide entrance and a freestanding named sign on its left clear of all posts. No HUD, characters, pasted product thumbnails, labels over props, clutter over the central field, bright floor rings, warning patterns or laser beams. Avoid the appearance of a plain empty concrete bowl with identical repeating walls. Give the perimeter meaningful layered scenery and asymmetry. Small clean upper-left version label only.
